title: Sheffield Edwards gives the green light at the Fontainebleau Hotel

plain: In 1960, at the Fontainebleau Hotel in Miami, a CIA security official named Sheffield Edwards came to a meeting with the mob figures Johnny Roselli, Sam Giancana and Santo Trafficante Jr. and the private investigator Bob Maheu. Going by the code name "Mr. Ed", he gave the plan they were discussing the go-ahead. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this, passing on what he was told, in a conversation about John F. Kennedy. If true, it would mean the CIA itself approved a working partnership with organised crime.
